jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML engineering for customer risk scoring, fraud analytics, document intelligence, RAG systems, and GenAI applications.
achievements: Developed machine learning pipelines using TensorFlow and AWS SageMaker for customer risk scoring, optimizing training workflows and cloud resource utilization to reduce infrastructure costs by 32% while maintaining model performance.
Created scalable PySpark and PostgreSQL data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature-engineering pipelines for near real-time fraud analytics, increasing end-to-end processing throughput by 2.6x.

Applied transformer-based NLP models including BERT and LLaMA for Named Entity Recognition and information extraction from financial documents, achieving 97% precision across critical entity categories.

Engineered Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, and FAISS to analyze unstructured financial documents, enabling sub-second retrieval and improving analyst decision-making accuracy by 34%.
Deployed ML and GenAI applications using Docker, FastAPI, and AWS Lambda, implementing CI/CD workflows for testing, model versioning, and deployment while improving release consistency by 35%.
Integrated LLM agents, RAG, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) using LangGraph to improve context management and natural-language query resolution, increasing query-resolution efficiency by 41%.

jobs.title: Jr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: Machine learning, analytics, ETL, anomaly detection, NLP, and dashboarding for customer, transactional, and operational datasets.
achievements: Developed and tuned supervised machine learning models using Decision Trees, Random Forests, Naive Bayes, and XGBoost, reducing manual risk-assessment time by 32% for customer churn and risk prediction workflows.

Performed exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis, and hypothesis testing using Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Excel, contributing to a 17% reduction in operational costs by identifying business and operational trends.
Built feature engineering, data preprocessing, and ETL pipelines using PySpark and SQL Server, achieving a 43% reduction in recurring data-preparation time across data processing workflows.
Applied K-Means, DBSCAN, and PCA to segment transaction data and identify anomalous patterns, enabling the detection of 58% more potential fraud cases compared with existing rule-based approaches.

Developed RNN and CNN deep-learning models using Keras and PyTorch for sentiment analysis and performance evaluation techniques to improve F1-score by 24% over baseline models across structured and unstructured datasets.
Utilized NLP workflows using BERT, NLTK, and spaCy for named entity recognition and model evaluation techniques to improve classification precision by 28% across customer and transactional datasets.

Employed interactive Power BI dashboards with Azure Machine Learning APIs to monitor model performance, business KPIs, and data-quality metrics, improving reporting visibility by 36% and supporting faster business decisions.
